decision_scope: Exact4 implementation and new fixture-source review only; Root supervised fixture result is a separate evidence gate

diagnostic_events.detail: Both raw NormalHome/USERPROFILE predicates now call sameQualificationNormalHome. Shared pure helper permits case and slash spelling of the same already-normalized absolute path, rejects changed identity and malformed spelling, and performs no filesystem or authority lookup. Original consumed flow01 remains failed and unreplayed.

source_review: Production delta is exactly the shared unexported predicate plus the two call-site substitutions. Host OS-account lookup, NormalHome storage, B1 constructor and readiness, public DTO, source/helper/native seals, private failure facts, environment hashing, launch budget and Job limits are unchanged.

Predicate applies filepath.FromSlash to each side, requires nonempty absolute already-clean form, rejects dot/parent/duplicate or trailing-separator nonclean forms, Win32 wildcard/reserved punctuation/semicolon/control characters, and invalid/extra colon. Equality remains EqualFold of the same lexical absolute location; no EvalSymlinks or fallback path resolution.

The trusted side remains Host-produced OS-account NormalHome. USERPROFILE can only match it. No new public/test provider, environment authority, arbitrary profile selection, credential read or readiness grant was introduced.

Existing exactReal ancestor/reparse checks on qualification root/source/helper and later receipt files remain byte-unchanged. Pure string comparison does not establish filesystem reparse safety and cannot authorize a different alias by resolving it.

capture validator still hashes the exact supplied environment vector, actual ordered argv/plan/native/helper/limits and immutable typed context. No rewrite of NormalHome or environment is performed; final persisted intent byte digest and sameQualificationPrelaunchContext comparison remain exact and unchanged.
fixture_review: 17 table cases cover same/backslash, forward slash, mixed case/separators, different user/prefix/drive/root, empty trusted/profile, relative/drive-relative, dot/parent, NUL/CRLF, semicolon and invalid character. This is source enumeration, not a test PASS claim.

Positive early-gate test uses qualifiedFixture t.TempDir with inert synthetic native/helper byte files; canonical trusted home plus slash USERPROFILE passes the actual ensureLaunch gate. A deliberately wrong helper SHA requires QUALIFICATION_BOOTSTRAP_BLOCKED, nonempty receipt path, PreflightNoChild, PID0 and FAILED.

The positive early fixture invokes existing exactReal and PrivateDirectory only for synthetic temp root/receipts; deferred failed-capture receipt is written there. Native digest matches inert file, helper digest mismatches before QW/D, source controls, listener, collector, Job child or RPC start. No normal HOME ACL/file access occurs.

Negative changed/empty early fixtures require scope mismatch and absence of receipts; source ordering rejects before filesystem effects. The fake qualifier starts with prior test-only observation/state but ensureLaunch defer produces FAILED; no readiness is asserted.

Intent spelling fixture calls actual qualificationIntentRecord using existing fake collector inputs and no collector invocation. Given env/hash pair remains internally consistent while raw process USERPROFILE changes; this isolates the home predicate and does not purport to test a live environment mutation. Changed/empty profile rejects.
Existing final-link context/byte tampering fixtures remain unchanged, including changed valid SourceBindingHash/TaskID/HostBuildHash rejection. There is no new real child execution in added tests.
limits: Static source approval is not compile success, fixture PASS or effective Native qualification. Root test01 was announced but no outcome has been audited here.
The original flow01 timeout/Task failure and consumed scope are preserved. This fix does not authorize replay, another Task or a new Native/model attempt.
Pure tests cannot prove real account/reparse/ACL enforcement. Any future live attempt requires integrated source, fresh bundle bindings and independently authorized new scope.
Author reports a prior PATH gofmt lookup failure in diagnostics; reviewer did not reproduce it and does not count it as a product failure.
